pr_title: Count the lines on a receipt

comments.comment: The new progress-log entry names pull request #14 and issue #9 as bare text, though AGENTS.md says to link every one a document mentions and never to write a bare #12.
comments.failureScenario: The entry writes "Pull request #14" and "issue #9" as bare text. AGENTS.md says "Link every GitHub issue and pull request you mention in a document" and "Never write a bare #12."; GitHub links neither in a Markdown file, so a reader of the log cannot reach the pull request or the issue.
